pr_comments:
I don't think https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/7629 is fixed by this, though. I think there is lots to improve in terms of `step` (interval). I think the lowest-level subquery interval should be passed as step.

Also it would be nice to add test cases for multiple nested subqueries within one query? :thinking:

```
		query: "count_over_time((foo offset 10s)[2m:1s] offset 10s)", start: 300000, end: 500000,
￼		expected: []*storage.SelectHints{
￼			{Start: 155000, End: 480000, Func: "count_over_time", Step: **1000**},
￼		},
```
Sounds like that is the case
@bwplotka I think it is all addressed. WDYT?
